doc.name: THE ISS
doc.title: THE PASSING LIGHT
doc.blurb: The space station crossing at dusk: a steady cream point that never twinkles, no cross, brighter than any star for the thirty-five seconds it takes to cross, then gone into Earth's shadow before the far side. The short bright streak behind it is the store's way of saying it moves.
doc.where: SS_DECOR (MENU SKY) seat [120,240] on the pass line (0,260) to (420,90), climbing right at 12 px/s, gone into Earth's shadow at 70% (THE SKY CATALOG §4 row 4).
